posts.title: Opportunity of mutual profit and gain discovered: Cloud Fronts Group offer to the Mayor of Killeen, Texas
posts.body:
Cloud Fronts Group offer to the Mayor of Killeen, Texas, both residing and doing business with and for the benefit of the residents of the city as well as their clients, in the payment for services of building, hosting and verifying an informational site for the Mayor's office at mayor[surname].com (today, mayorsolomon.com, for Mayor Joseph Solomon).
The site would explain notices and new laws affecting residents, in the style of a law-firm client alert, and mirror (never replace) the City's official postings on killeentexas.gov.
The dilemma: who decides that a notice is authentic and fit to post. Proposed: the council member for the affected district signs off as advisory input, and the Mayor and City Manager make the final decision, so no single council member's framing decides what residents see.
Payment only through a lawful channel confirmed by counsel (City procurement or officeholder funds); the domain would be registered to the Mayor's office, not to Cloud Fronts Group, and only with the Mayor's written consent.
Disclosure: posted by Scott Weeden, who operates Legal Luminary and holds a partnership stake in Cloud Fronts Group. Not endorsed or accepted by the Mayor or the City.
